title: Why tokenisation can help shape the next era of UK growth
summary: As Barclays – in collaboration with PwC - releases a new report, “Rewiring Finance: Tokenisation as a Catalyst for UK Growth”, Matt Hammerstein, CEO of Barclays UK Corporate Bank, sets out the scale of the opportunity of tokenisation and what comes next.
body_markdown: This paper examines whether a US-style “baby bond” model, seeding investment accounts at birth and enabling long-term contributions, could help deepen market participation and unlock greater flows of capital into UK equities.
